title: Studio Automations: keyboard focus drops to the page after toggling a writable flow's definition switch
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29228 (PR #29375; report comment 6578318854, `/mnt/project-files/issue-29228/os-dev-report.md`, live capture `/mnt/project-files/issue-29228/live/definition-switch.json`) · filed by `domain:ui#3` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** An author who works by keyboard or screen reader turns a writable package's flow on or off from Studio's Automations list. After each flip, focus drops to the page body, so they must tab back from the top to reach the switch again, and a screen reader says nothing about where they are. #29228 (PR #29375) fixes this for the flow ledger switch (a package flow's per-deployment on/off); the flow's own definition switch beside it has the same defect.

**Measured (the #29228 os-dev, live in Chromium 153 on a fresh showcase).** A scratch writable package (`POST /api/v1/packages`) with one flow (draft `PUT`); on Studio → Automations, focus the flow's definition switch and press Space: the draft save answers `PUT 200`, and afterwards `document.activeElement` is `<body>`.

**Mechanism (read at `origin/main` `5924e500`).** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:10838` draws the switch with `disabled={!isEditable || !!saving || readOnly}`, and `toggleEnabled` sets `saving = 'draft'` for the save. A focused control that becomes `disabled` loses focus, and nothing returns it when `saving` clears. Same shape as #29228.

**Wanted.** After a keyboard toggle (saved or refused), focus is on the switch. While the save is in flight the switch still cannot be toggled twice. A non-editable or read-only switch stays non-interactive as today. Reuse PR #29375's approach where it fits (`aria-disabled` plus a guarded handler while busy, `disabled` only for the non-interactive cases).

**Tests.** Drive the switch by keyboard, resolve the save (success and a refusal), pin `document.activeElement` on the switch; a second Space while saving sends no second request. Ablation (back to `disabled` while saving) goes red.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the definition switch only). Serialize after PR #29375 (#29228).

Dedupe: `is:issue definition switch focus`, `is:issue auto flow switch keyboard focus`, `is:issue saving disabled focus Studio Automations`, `is:issue role=switch focus body` 54, 12, 3 and 3 hits (only #29228, QA runs, epics and seat posts; none on this switch). No card covers the definition switch.

Links back: #29228, PR #29375.
